status: frozen after the scalar topology gate passed, but before any gain-history array was copied or any calibration event energy was recalculated
purpose: Apply three preregistered branch-level gain candidates to high-resolution pixel-12 calibration events with the audited HEASoft rslpha2pi runtime, preserving outputs for a separately frozen spectral gate without inspecting any cluster event.

candidates.name: branch_median_common_mode
candidates.residual_rule: add the frozen branch median calibration-pixel residual to every pixel

candidates.name: branch_linear_common_mode
candidates.residual_rule: add a line passing through the frozen branch median at the branch midpoint with the frozen residual slope

synthetic_drift_history.template_row_rule: copy the nearest full Fe-55 gain-history row for the same pixel from the preregistered anchor segment; only TIME and TEMP_FIT are modified
synthetic_drift_history.temperature_rule: evaluate the frozen branch pixel fit at each endpoint, then add the candidate residual
synthetic_drift_history.copy_only_array_rule: non-scalar gain-history fields are copied solely to preserve the mission FITS schema and are never inspected, summarized, fitted, or used to select a candidate

event_selection.expression: TIME within the exact branch interval AND PIXEL==12 AND ITYPE==0

terminal_gate.decision_rule: Authorize freezing a calibration-pixel line-shape gate only if all 21 candidate-branch applications pass. Do not inspect centroids, widths, or any energy distribution in this protocol.

claim_boundary: A successful application proves only that each frozen calibration candidate is executable and complete on pixel-12 events.
No candidate may be preferred until the separately frozen centroid-and-width gate is run.
These calibration branches and residuals are observation-reduction nuisances, never Sigma Gravity parameters.
